title: ME60408: Mechanics Of Composites
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Definition of composites; Micromechanics of composites: effective properties of
long and short fiber reinforced composites, effective strength of composites,
effective properties of piezoelectric fiber reinforced composites; Ply
mechanics; Macromechanics of laminated composite structures: description of
laminates, laminate moduli, static and dynamic analysis of laminated composite
structures (beams, plates and shells) using shear deformation theories, failure
theories, analysis of impact on laminates; Analysis of smart composite
structures.
